subject.title: [Bug]: scripts/pr GraphQL sync can lose rebased ancestry

question: Should script owners rebase/review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98765 as the fix for this issue, or narrow/reject the fail-closed repair direction?
rationale: The issue is valid by source inspection, but the open fix changes protected maintainer PR publication semantics and is currently conflicting, so automation should not replace the maintainer choice.

options.title: Rebase and review the repair PR
options.body: Bring the open repair PR up to current main, resolve conflicts, and review the stricter GraphQL/git publication behavior before merge.

options.title: Narrow to refusal-only
options.body: If the explicit ancestry-repair mode is too much surface, land only the unsafe GraphQL refusal and track repair mode separately.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: If maintainers want to preserve the old GraphQL fallback behavior, close the issue and repair PR with that policy decision.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review the repair PR
recommendation.body: Bring the open repair PR up to current main, resolve conflicts, and review the stricter GraphQL/git publication behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this report and the open repair PR, and have recent history in the affected PR tooling path.
